objective: Phase 1E: Shortage Alerts - Derived alert generation from forecast and safety buffer threshold, breach explanation, source record linking, and UI alert drawer/panel
acceptance_criteria: Alert generation service derived deterministically from 14-day cash-flow forecast and merchant safety buffer
Identify lowest dip date, severity (critical for below zero, warning for below safety buffer), deficit amount in integer paise, and threshold
Attribution of contributing events (which bills cause the deficit, which expected collections are missing or delayed)
API endpoint GET /api/v1/alerts returning active alerts with structured contributing events and suggested mitigation actions
Frontend Alert Banner / Panel in DashboardPage and CashFlowPage linking directly to contributing records
Unit and API tests verifying alert generation, severity differentiation, and non-duplicate generation
Frontend build succeeds with zero errors

evidence.pytest: 28 passed in 0.56s (test_alerts.py, test_api.py, test_forecast.py, test_ledger.py, test_money.py, test_suppliers_expenses.py)

non_goals: Do not use LLM for alert triggers (must be purely deterministic based on numbers)
Do not hardcode alerts; derive dynamically from current business balances, bills, and collections
